answer: Proposal: mature reward seats in a fixed-rate queue. Registration locks a bond in one FIFO queue; only R seats mature per epoch — the sole oasis — pure chain state. Waiting runs T = Q/R epochs through a dry canyon, the bond umber and idle: time, not work, so split wallets and hardware cannot widen R. A burst of N masks idles ≈N²/2R seat-epochs — the farm's own rush costs quadratic lock time. Drip attacks stay linear: each head pays T of dead lock, winning only where lifetime reward clears that interest. Seams: honest entrants wait; resale bypasses the gate.
